title: Release visuals: catalog screenshots for model launches and sunset notices
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce a cohesive set of product screenshots and quickstart visuals for the upcoming catalog release that covers both newly added models and models being deprecated. Assets will be used in release notes, the console model catalog, and onboarding quickstarts.

Deliverables:
- Catalog tile variations: launch (badge: New), stable (recommended), experimental, and sunset (deprecation banner). Include model name, version tag, perf badges (latency/cost), and exportable metadata overlay.
- Release note hero screenshot (desktop + mobile): shows new-model callout and migration CTA for deprecated models.
- Quickstart code snippet screenshots: 3 variants (Python REST, Node SDK, cURL) with the new model set in the request payload; highlight the model selector in the console.
- Migration guidance panels: screenshots illustrating suggested fallback model mapping and pricing delta visualization.
- Accessibility checks: high-contrast deprecation banner, screen-reader alt text for each image, and keyboard-focus state for the model card.
- Localization: English and German text overlays for primary screenshots (primary markets).

Specs and constraints:
- Resolutions: 1440x900 (desktop hero), 1200x628 (social card), 390x844 (mobile). Export PNG and SVG where appropriate.
- Use console theming tokens; request latest tokens from frontend (ENG-2678) before final export.
- Include unobtrusive watermark for internal review versions.

Acceptance criteria:
- All deliverables uploaded to the shared Drive folder with naming convention: catalog_release_2026-03_<asset>-<locale>-<res>.png.
- Design review sign-off from PM (James Li) and Eng owner (Nora Patel).
- PR created linking images to release-notes markdown and Console PR.
- QA checklist passed by Solutions Design and Accessibility reviewer.
